bio:
Ben Broome is an independent curator, artist, writer & founder of New Spaces CIO. 

Recent projects include Rooms of Neighbours (2026), an exhibition across domestic and communal areas of Clifton Crescent in South London, UK; Ladji Diaby: Who's Gonna Save The World?(2026) at Lafayette Anticipations, Paris, France; Racheal Crowther: Gebrauchsmusik (2025) at Galerie Noah Klink, Berlin, Germany; and Performance By, an iterative series presenting live music and performance art in underused public space. He lives and works in London, UK.
